chunks: From him, from Al-Sayyari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn Al-Mubarak Al-Dinawari, from Abu Uthman, from Durust, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The onion improves the breath, strengthens the back, and softens the skin.
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of onions according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) reflects the Prophetic tradition of *Tibb al-Nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine), emphasizing the holistic health benefits of common foods. It underscores the Shia scholarly appreciation for empirical observation of dietary impacts on physical vitality, specifically linking onion consumption to respiratory freshness, musculoskeletal strength, and dermatological health.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Al Sayyari, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ahmad Bin Al Mubarak Al Deynaoury, from Abu Usman, from Dorost, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said;
‘The onion aromatises the breath, and strengthens the back, and softens the skin’.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from al-Sayyariy from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Ahmad ibn al- Mubarak al-Daynawariy from abu ‘Uthman from Durust who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Onion gives fine flavor, strengthens one’s back and clears the skin.’”
